results.fact: Summit-day length and start time: partner_requirements vs timing/itinerary
results.evidence: Third pass. The archived peak page gives the Northeast Couloir only as Grade II or III, steep couloir to 60 degrees, winter/early-spring route, with no times; the reports that surface for camp departures (4:30 AM) and lake approaches (5-6 h in snow) concern the neighbouring North Buttress Couloir. No source states a camp-to-camp time or a start time for this couloir, so neither partner_requirements' 04:00 / 8.5 h nor timing's 2:30 AM / 11 h can be adopted.

Third pass. The first-ascent party's own forum trip report (archived) names the route 'Holsten-Hilden 1,600 ft WI3 M6, steep snow' with no Roman numeral; the regional new-route register lists the January 2011 ascent without a grade; a list of forgotten Cascade alpine ice routes does not grade it. The only numerals remain IV (the AAJ first-ascent note) and III (the route listing), one source each, so neither numeral nor a III-IV range (needs two sources per end) can be adopted.

results.fact: Published approach time 4 hr vs itinerary 5-6 hr to Fish Creek Pass
results.evidence: Third pass. Two dated trailhead-to-pass times were found, and they disagree with each other and with both row figures in different ways: a 2020 GPS-timed day party took 3 h 05 min (04:00 to 07:05) and a 2023 day hiker on snow took about 4 h. Both are light day-pack times; neither addresses the itinerary's 32 lb overnight pack, and no two sources give the same figure, so neither approachTimeHrs 4 nor the schedule's +5 to 6 hr is changed.

Third pass. The AAJ note on the 1963 outing places both of that day's new routes on Crooked Thumb's EAST face from a Challenger Arm base camp; the fa party (Ardussi, Magnusson, Mech, Swanson) took a diagonal class-5 gully and chimney to the first notch north of the summit, then the ridge and ledges. The row's line starts on the WEST side: from the Crooked Thumb Glacier moraine camp beneath the west face, up the northwest couloir to a north-ridge notch, around pinnacles, a headwall and west-face ledges to the south ridge (the 2016 ascent report). So fa names the party of a different start that may share the upper ridge, and beta's 'Beckey-era first ascent' is the peak's 1940 FA with no source for the Beckeys' line. No source names who first climbed the northwest-couloir start; setting fa to null would need the two lines to be shown fully distinct, which the shared upper ridge prevents. Owner decision on route identity.

results.evidence: Decision rule 4. The 7,800 ft on the moraine-camp waypoint is contradicted by: the USGS elevation service at the waypoint's own coordinate (~7,025 ft); a 2017 traverse report that camped on the Crooked Thumb Glacier at 6,800 ft and then moved about 500 ft higher; and the 2016 ascent report, whose only 7,800 ft figure is the forced bivouac ledge on the north ridge, not the moraine camp. bivy[0] says 7,200 ft but no second source states that figure, so the waypoint elevation is cleared rather than replaced.

results.evidence: Third pass. An archived peak page for this south slope/ridge route lists its season as winter, says the slope would be an oven in mid-summer and waterless in late summer, reports a January ascent, and suggests warm spring weather would be pleasant; it states no month window. Together with the dated ascents already found (April, late May, early June, and a winter one), the sources lean to a snow season and contradict best_season/seasonal_guidance's late-July-to-September optimum. But no two sources state the same window (the header's Mar-May leaves out the early-June ascents), and replacing the summer guidance would mean new month-by-month prose without a stated window to write, so no patch.

Third pass. New reports give whole-day figures only: a 2015 solo party took 8+ hours round trip with 45 min on the summit and long breaks, a 2014 Memorial Day party gives start time but no descent time, a 2016 report and a 2025 report describe the descent route without times; the one timed summit-to-car figure remains one 2015 party (summit 11:43 AM, car 4:14 PM, about 4.5 h including any summit stay). No two sources state the same summit-to-trailhead time, so neither descentTimeHrs 2.5 nor the schedule's 3.75 h is adopted.
